items.proposedConcept: Hands rotate the same horizontal board/rectangular object upright; clear actor/orientation change.

review.rationale: Stopping requires a change from movement to stillness and differs from someone actively stopping another object.
review.recommendation: Show an object moving and then halted, with no external agent supplying the stop; use sentence context to teach 止める versus 止まる.
review.currentVisualConcept: Moving ball halts against a firm stop bar.
review.currentVisualReviewNote: Motion lines terminate at barrier to symbolize stopping.

items.proposedConcept: Same rolling ball or vehicle moves then comes to rest; solid final object, subdued start pose and motion marks that cease, no external person stopping it.

review.rationale: Taking something out is visible if an actor moves an object across a container boundary.
review.recommendation: Show a hand lifting a ball out of an open box with a clear rim and before-and-after positions.
review.currentVisualConcept: Ball is lifted out of an open box.

items.proposedConcept: Hand lifts same ball out of open box across clear rim; paired design to 入れる, final ball outside.

review.rationale: Vehicle movement can be observed, whereas a travel scene may incorrectly suggest tourism.
review.recommendation: Show the same vehicle progressing along a road in a short sequence; clarify the gloss as vehicle travel or running rather than travel in general.
review.currentVisualConcept: Vehicle moves along a road with strong motion streaks.
review.currentVisualReviewNote: Vehicle motion represents traveling/running of a vehicle, rather than tourism.

items.proposedConcept: Same simple vehicle progresses along road, two compact positions and motion cues; avoid luggage/map/holiday symbols suggesting tourism.
